tmp:3263: the great tzaddikim's concealing of their Torah by burning and destroying it — a deliberate act to remove the spirit of jealousy and protect the peace of the holy couple
tmp:3264: godel ha-ahavah — the greatness/intensity of love, the cause on account of which the spirit of jealousy arises even among the pure
tmp:3265: the act of being jealous over her — the spirit of jealousy's zealous guarding of the beloved (the holy couple), an expression of true love per the Zohar
tmp:3266: ruach kin'ah — the 'spirit of jealousy' (Numbers 5:14), identified as the spirit of Mashiach that is zealous against adultery
tmp:3268: bechinat Mashiach — the 'aspect of Mashiach,' a messianic quality/level present within a person or a tzaddik's Torah-book
tmp:3269: 'according to his holiness and purity' — the measure of a person's sanctity and purity that determines the degree of the aspect of Mashiach he possesses
tmp:3270: the state of possessing an aspect of Mashiach — having a share of the messianic spirit by virtue of one's holiness
tmp:3271: 'My Name that was written in holiness' (sotah-scroll phrase) — the divine Name inscribed in sanctity that spreads through the world and makes a name, identified with the holy book (sefer = shem by gematria)
tmp:3273: hitnotzetzut — the sparkling/flashing of light that flashes from one joy to its fellow when joys are included together
tmp:3274: the growing and increase of the light — the intensification of joy's radiance produced by joys being merged at their root
tmp:3275: kelaliyut — the inclusiveness whereby one joy is incorporated into its fellow, the mechanism that magnifies joy's light
tmp:3276: the maximal magnification of the light of the joys — the greatly increased radiance resulting from all joys being included together at their single root
tmp:3277: coming to mochin de-gadlut — the transition to expanded consciousness (kabbalistic 'mentalities of greatness'), identified as hamtakah (sweetening of judgments)
tmp:3278: seeing the tzaddik in his beauty and splendor — beholding the true tzaddik at the time of the gathering (kibbutz), the fulfillment of 'the king in his beauty shall your eyes behold' (Isaiah 33:17)
tmp:3279: merchakim — 'far distances' (Isaiah 33:17 'eretz merchakim'), a name for chokhmah/wisdom perceived from afar, linked to the Land of Israel
tmp:3281: receiving from the hitpa'arut — obtaining pe'er (glory) and mochin from beholding God's glorying in Israel, which forms tefillin within the beholder
tmp:3282: bechinat einayim — the 'aspect of eyes': spiritual eyes formed when the tefillin-mochin break through, becoming like the eyes of Hashem that watch over the Land
tmp:3284: hitpa'arut — God's glorying/taking pride (in Israel), the divine self-adornment from which the tefillin-pe'er and divine 'eyes' of providence are formed
tmp:3285: the souls of Israel as the object of God's glory — nishmot Yisrael in whom God takes pride ('Israel in whom I glory,' Isaiah 49:3), the source arousing divine providence
tmp:3286: hitpatchut ha-chokhmah — the opening/unfolding of wisdom, the intellectual expansion produced by the air of the Land of Israel that makes wise
tmp:3287: God's constant gazing at the Land of Israel — perpetual divine providence over Eretz Yisrael ('the eyes of Hashem are upon it from year's beginning to year's end')
tmp:3288: the sanctity of the Land of Israel and its wisdom-conferring air — Eretz Yisrael's property of sanctifying and its atmosphere that 'makes wise' (avira de-Eretz Yisrael machkim)
tmp:3289: speaking faith aloud with the mouth — the verbal articulation of emunah, which itself constitutes faith and brings one to faith ('I will make known Your faithfulness with my mouth,' Ps 89)
tmp:3290: ha-nekudah ha-penimit — the inner point: Shabbat as the central point from which the six weekdays (the surrounding circles) draw sustenance; symbol of the true tzaddik one travels to
tmp:3291: the obstacles, incitements, and enticements — the kelipah-generated hindrances that block one from reaching the tzaddik, mere illusions like the Baal Shem Tov's imaginary walls
tmp:3292: chomot — the illusory walls of the Baal Shem Tov's parable, conjured by the king around his treasure; obstacles that are only achizat einayim (optical illusion)
tmp:3293: speaking of the salvation of Israel — discourse about yeshu'at Yisrael, the holy speech near which the subtle kelipah lurks at the giving-over of Torah
tmp:3294: the fleeing of the subtle kelipah — the escape/dispersal of the fine husk that borders holiness when it is denied nurture during the tzaddik's Torah teaching
tmp:3295: doing acts of silliness, laughter, jumping and dancing — deliberate foolish merriment used as a device to attain and maintain joy
tmp:3296: 'and then it will depart' — the withdrawal of the disturbing thought/evil inclination when one stubbornly refuses to attend to it
tmp:3297: the evil inclination's departure — the yetzer hara giving up and going away when a person is firm-minded and obstinate against it
tmp:3299: the fittingness of there being unanswerable questions upon God — kushiyot on the Blessed One as proper and beautiful given His exaltedness beyond our minds
tmp:3300: God's immense greatness and exaltedness beyond our understanding — the very transcendence that makes it necessarily impossible for our minds to grasp Him, hence the questions
tmp:3302: revealing chasadim — the disclosure of divine kindnesses effected through revealing novel Torah insights (chiddushei Torah)
tmp:3303: the flowing of God's divinity, as it were, into the 'runnels of the brains' (rehatei mochin) — Godliness drawn down into the channels of the mind through Torah innovation
tmp:3304: tefisah — the prison/imprisonment: Rabbi Akiva's incarceration, attributed by Rabbi Shimon to his expounding Torah publicly before unworthy hearers
tmp:3305: the drawing down of Elokut — divinity being drawn into the world through revealed Torah innovations ('that they take for Me an offering')
tmp:3306: kesil — the 'fool': the unworthy hearer of Torah (also the star-name Kesil/Orion), into whom honor is diverted when unfit students listen
tmp:3307: talmid she-eino hagun — an unworthy/unfit student whose hearing of publicly taught Torah causes withholding of rain
tmp:3309: chiluf ha-kavod — the exchange/diversion of honor: glory passing from the Torah to the unworthy, disrupting the cloud-and-rain flow that depends on kevod HaShem
